name: Neoclassicism and Rococo
intro: From Watteau's fêtes galantes to David's Revolution, the eighteenth century swung from pleasure to virtue. This section follows that swing through sixty-seven works, with the facts of each object drawn from museum collection records.
homeDescription: Sixty-eight works trace the century from Rococo Paris, Venice and Bavaria through Chardin, Greuze and Hogarth to Rome, Winckelmann, Canova and David.
ldDescription: An artwork-by-artwork guide to Rococo and Neoclassical art, 1700s–1800s, compiled from museum collection records.
sourcesDescription: Lectures, curricula, museum collection records and reference sources used to compile {name}.
